description:
Clock and weather wallpaper styled as a JavaScript object. Shows the time, date, current weather and the track that is playing, over a sky with a sun and moon that follow the real sunrise and sunset, with the real moon phase.

Set your city in the wallpaper properties (City). Leave it empty to use your approximate location. Format: "city, province/state, country".

Weather animations (rain, snow, clouds, storms, falling leaves and petals) can be turned off with the Weather option.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com/), licensed under CC BY 4.0.
title: Clock and Weather JavaScript Wallpaper
